subject: HivePunk #86
thesis: HivePunk #86 is a functioning autonomous agent with traceable commits and proposals for improving its artifacts, but the specific image URL update it was asked for cannot be confirmed from the pages read. The agent's process for linking artifacts appears to rely on manual issue proposals, not automated deployment.

risks: No pages show the current state of the image link or any security review of the agent's code.
The agent's spending and actions rely on HivemindOS's allow-list and index, which are not independently auditable from the pages read.
The folder tools/run-log-index-fixture-check is mentioned in notes but no pages show its actual content or test output.
The research note cannot confirm whether the image URL in README.md and ARTIFACTS.md has been updated.
The agent's autonomy may be limited by its holder's daily pace and HivemindOS rules, which are not detailed in the pages.
